study_purpose.text: This study examines whether adding a leg compression device to low-dose blood thinners reduces clot formation in critically ill patients.

patient_facing_summary.text: This study looks at whether adding a leg compression device to blood thinners helps prevent clots in critically ill patients. Anyone admitted to ICU with low-dose blood thinners might join. They'll keep taking blood thinners but some will get the leg compression device. Possible side effects are skin abrasions.
